titulo: Just in case, to top it all
intro: Por and para at B2: the contrasts that change the meaning, and the fixed phrases.
p.por si acaso.consejo: It is written as three words and used on its own: «llévate el paraguas, por si acaso».
p.por fin.consejo: It expresses relief after a wait: «¡por fin llegas!».
p.por poco.consejo: It goes with the present for something that almost happened: «por poco me caigo» (I did not fall).
p.para colmo.consejo: It adds a final problem: «y, para colmo, llovía». «El colmo» is the limit.
p.para variar.consejo: It is often ironic: «llegó tarde, para variar». It means it is the usual thing.
p.por mí.consejo: «Por mí, vale» means «I don't mind». Here «mí» has an accent.
p.para mí.consejo: «Para mí, es un error» gives an opinion. It can also be «es para mí», a gift.
p.no es para tanto.glosa: it's not such a big deal
p.no es para tanto.consejo: It plays something down: «no es para tanto». You say it to someone who exaggerates.
p.despistado.consejo: The feminine is «despistada». You say «ser despistado» for something habitual.
p.atasco.consejo: You say «hay un atasco». The s is clear: a-TAS-ko.
p.gasolina.consejo: You say «me quedé sin gasolina». The g sounds hard (ga).
p.paraguas.consejo: It is masculine and does not change in the plural: «el paraguas», «los paraguas». The «gu» sounds «gw».
b1.texto:
**Por** looks at what lies behind: the cause (por amor), the doer (escrito **por**), the exchange (lo compré **por** diez euros), on someone's behalf (hazlo **por** mí), the way through (**por** el parque), rough time and place (**por** la mañana, **por** aquí), the means (**por** correo), the rate (dos veces **por** semana), and what is still to do (queda mucho **por** hacer).

**Para** looks ahead: the purpose, the receiver, the direction (salgo **para** Madrid), the deadline (**para** el lunes), an opinion (**para mí**), an employer (trabajo **para** un banco), and a comparison with what you would expect: **para ser** extranjero, habla muy bien.

Minimal pairs: lo hice **por ti** (because of you) and lo hice **para ti** (to give to you). **Por mí**, vale (I don't mind) and **para mí**, es un error (in my view).

**Estar para** is to be about to, or in the mood for: no estoy **para** bromas. **Estar por** is to be inclined to, or still to be done.
b2.f2.texto: To top it all, I ran out of petrol in the traffic jam.
b2.f3.texto: It's not such a big deal.
b2.f5.texto: I've got it, just in case.
b2.f6.texto: In my opinion, it is going to rain today.
b2.f7.texto: As far as I'm concerned, we can go now.
b2.f8.texto: For someone so absent-minded, you've come very well prepared today.
b2.f9.texto: For a change, I haven't lost my keys today.
b3.titulo: Por and para in set phrases
b4.texto:
- lo hice **por** ti (because of you) / lo hice **para** ti (to give to you)
- gracias **por** venir / estudio **para** aprender
- pasé **por** Madrid (through) / salgo **para** Madrid (towards)
- lo compré **por** diez euros / es **para** el lunes
- **por** mí, vale (I don't mind) / **para** mí, es un error (in my view)
b4.e0.texto: I did it because of you.
b4.e2.texto: There is a lot still to do.
b5.f0.texto: The station smells of wet iron and freshly made coffee.
b5.f1.texto: At last, the train appears through the mist with a long whistle.
b5.f2.texto: An absent-minded traveller runs along the platform with his coat open.
b5.f3.texto: He nearly drops his suitcase under the wheels of the train.
b5.f4.texto: To top it all, a fine rain begins to fall on the closed umbrellas.
b5.f5.texto: The traveller gets on the carriage and sits down by the window.
b5.f6.texto: Through the window, the city drifts away like an ink drawing.
b5.f7.texto: For a change, the sky opens and lets a ray of sun through.
b5.f8.texto: For such a grey day, the landscape shines with a strange light.
b5.f9.texto: For now, the traveller only wants to close his eyes and listen to the train.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «por ti» expresses the cause, because of you.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Para ti» would be to give it to you, not on your account.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «De ti» would mean «about you» or «from you».
b6.pregunta: Think of the cause, not of a gift.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: I did not fall, it was close.
b7.o1.refuerzo: No: «por poco» does not speak of how much you fall.
b7.o2.refuerzo: No: it does not speak of time, but of it almost happening.
b7.pregunta: What does «por poco me caigo» mean?
b8.frase: Para colmo me quedé sin gasolina
b8.traduccion: To top it all, I ran out of petrol
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «para» compares with what is expected.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Por ser extranjero» would mean «because he is a foreigner».
b9.o2.refuerzo: «De» does not work for this comparison.
b9.pregunta: Compare with what is expected: choose the preposition.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Para mí» gives an opinion or names the receiver.
b11.o2.refuerzo: It would mean «for your sake», not «I don't mind».
b11.pregunta: A friend suggests a film and you don't mind. What do you say?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «por» + infinitive is what is still to be done.
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Para hacer» would give a purpose, not what remains.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «A hacer» is not used in this construction.
b12.pregunta: Choose the preposition for what remains.
p.pierdo.consejo: From «perder», to lose. The ie is a diphthong: PIER-do.
p.quedé.consejo: Past tense of «quedarse», to stay or be left. Stress on DE.
p.irnos.consejo: «Nos» at the end means «ourselves». Stress on IR: IR-nos.
p.preparado.consejo: Participle of «preparar», to prepare. Stress on RA.
p.asoma.consejo: From «asomar», to appear. Stress on SO: a-SO-ma.
p.silbido.consejo: Masculine, «el silbido». The b is written as b. Stress on BI.
p.extraña.consejo: Feminine of «extraño». The ñ sounds ny. Stress on TRA.
p.escuchar.consejo: The c before u is k. Stress on the last syllable: es-ku-CHAR.
p.caigo.consejo: From «caer», to fall. The ai is a diphthong: KAI-go.
p.extranjero.consejo: The j sounds like h, and the stress falls on HE: eks-tran-HE-ro.
